exposure: Location of Tregs (placental bed, uterine incision site, blood)
outcome: Transcriptional profile of Tregs (gene expression of FOXP3, CTLA-4, TIGIT, GITR, TNFR2, OX-40, 4-1BB, HAVCR2, IL10, LAYN, PDCD1, MAF, PRDM1, BATF, VDR)
cohort: The study participants were women with uncomplicated pregnancies undergoing cesarean section.
finding: Human uterine Tregs (uTregs) acquire a differentiated effector Treg profile similar to tumor-infiltrating Tregs, specifically at the materno-fetal interface.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, at the time of cesarean section
